chunks: Your Lord is the All-Sufficient, the Lord of Mercy. If He wills, He can remove you and make others succeed you, just as He raised you from the progeny of other people.

key_terms.الْغَنِيُّ: The All-Sufficient, One who needs nothing

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is Al-Ghani and how does He replace generations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute self-sufficiency (Al-Ghani) while affirming His mercy, illustrating His power to replace generations as He wills, akin to His creation of previous peoples. It serves as a profound reminder of divine authority and the transient nature of human existence, encouraging believers to reflect on their role within the continuum of prophetic history.
